record.title: Vioolsdrift staff protest closes cargo crossing May 2020
record.exceptions: Alternative route via Ariamsvlei remained available.
record.imposing_authority: South African immigration staff undertaking work stoppage
record.enforcement: Staff shut gates and stopped processing.
record.relationship: Local staff protest during concurrent SC02 South African and SC21 Namibian health restrictions; not another national COVID closure.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in cited sources; no assumption of present status.
record.official_rationale: Staff protested inadequate water supply; no state policy rationale attributed.
record.context: Intentional staff action prompted by utility failure, rather than passive technical unavailability.
record.uncertainty: Beginning approximately noon May 13; reopening by 22:00. New Era's secondary rendering says Tuesday evening, contrary to its TimesLive source and the Namibian Sun police account of a Wednesday closure; prefer those direct accounts. No unrestricted passenger travel claim.
